policy: Takoform has two independent release tracks. Normative Specification 1.0 closes only on an exact committed source snapshot, the fixed generator-owned multi-family candidate index reopened through every package, Definition, Interface, Binding, suite corpus, runner input, and referenced byte, and the manifest-owned deterministic reference-conformance execution. The current 0.x FormRefs remain exact and Experimental; releasing the Specification and Host API v1 does not relabel or promote them to Form 1.0.0. The current Edge family target is exactly 16/16 with no ObjectBucket Form, no edge.objects API, and no same-document bucket Resource link. The standards.takoform.com/v1 service slot accepts opaque reverse-DNS protocol identifiers unknown to Takoform; it is not a central protocol enum, while the v1alpha1 enum remains immutable history. Host-resolved endpoints and credentials never enter portable Form state. The official Terraform Provider 3.0 is an independent non-normative implementation milestone. External Hosts, backends, production consumers, Takoserver, Takosumi, and operator signatures are adoption evidence, not Takoform release authorities. Local origin/ref checks assume an already authenticated and freshly fetched canonical checkout; they prevent accidental repository substitution but are not remote provenance attestation. No status, caller list, generic pass result, or hand-written count in this file is trusted.
